business_model.claim: Central Garden & Pet is a U.S. consumer-goods company that reports in two segments, Pet and Garden.

business_model.claim: The Pet segment sells branded and private-label pet supplies: dog and cat treats, chews, toys, beds, grooming and waste-management items, plus aquatics, small animal, reptile and bird supplies, equine and animal health products, live fish and small animals, and outdoor cushions.

business_model.claim: The Garden segment sells lawn and garden consumables, including grass seed, packet seed, wild bird feed, herbicides and pesticides, fertilizers and live plants, under brands such as Pennington, Ferry-Morse, Amdro and Sevin.

quotes: Garden segment sales increased 1% to $1.3 billion, with growth in Fertilizer, Wild Bird, and Grass Seed.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the cited release. The conditions for recovery are inferred from the stated causes of the Q4 decline.
growth_thesis.claim: Pet organic growth is a smaller driver. Pet organic sales rose 1% in FY2026, led by Professional and Dog Treats. It would need to recover from the fourth-quarter organic decline of 5%, which management tied to softer demand, lost pet bed distribution and a temporary supply constraint.
quotes: Pet segment sales decreased 11% to $1.6 billion, while Pet organic sales increased 1%, led by growth in Professional and Dog Treats.

growth_thesis.claim: Acquisitions are the stated route to new revenue. Burpee closed on September 30, 2026. TRIXIE is expected to close in the second quarter of fiscal 2027 for €340 million in cash at closing and up to €400 million in total. Growth requires that TRIXIE clears regulatory approval and closes and that both deals are integrated.
quotes: The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
The transaction closed on September 30, 2026.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the cited release. The capacity reading is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: The balance sheet gives capacity to fund this growth. Year-end cash was $1,092 million, no credit facility borrowings were outstanding, and net leverage was 0.2x against gross leverage of 2.6x. The cash generation behind this must continue, and operating cash flow was $316 million.
quotes: Central had no borrowings outstanding under its credit facility at year-end.
Net leverage was 0.2x.

growth_thesis.basis: Inferred from the share counts and repurchase authorization in the cited release.
growth_thesis.claim: Share count reduction helped per-share growth. Diluted weighted shares were 61,971 against 63,815 (table in thousands), and diluted EPS was $3.03. This depends on continued repurchases, with $128 million remaining under authorizations.
quotes: As of September 26, 2026, $128 million remained available for future stock repurchases under Central's authorizations.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the cited release. The conditions are inferred from the outlook text.
growth_thesis.claim: Management does not guide to further earnings growth in fiscal 2027. It expects non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better after $3.00 in fiscal 2026, and a challenging first quarter. Growth would require improvement as the year progresses and a larger contribution from the acquisitions in fiscal 2028.
quotes: Central currently expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better.

material_events.claim: Central contributed its pet distribution business to a new partnership with Phillips Pet Food & Supplies. It received cash, a note receivable and a 20% interest in the new entity, and recognized a pre-tax gain of $2.5 million.
quotes: On April 13, 2026, we entered into a strategic partnership with Phillips Pet Food & Supplies
we recognized a pre-tax gain of $2.5 million during the quarter ended June 27, 2026

material_events.basis: Stated in the 10-Q subsequent-event note and the 8-K earnings release.
material_events.claim: Central announced a definitive agreement to acquire an 80% interest in TRIXIE, a European pet supplies company, for €340 million in cash at closing plus an earn-out of up to €60 million. Closing is expected in the second quarter of fiscal 2027 and is subject to regulatory approval and other customary closing conditions.
quotes: Central entered into a definitive agreement to acquire an 80% interest in TRIXIE Heimtierbedarf GmbH & Co. KG
for €340 million in cash at closing plus up to €60 million in additional earn-out payments
The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 8-K earnings release. The purchase price is not given in the packet.
material_events.claim: Central acquired W. Atlee Burpee Company (Burpee), a packet seed and young plant brand, after fiscal year end.
quotes: After fiscal year end, Central acquired W. Atlee Burpee Company
The transaction closed on September 30, 2026.

material_events.claim: In fiscal 2026 Central received tariff refunds that added $24 million of incremental gross profit. Management excluded the refunds from its non-GAAP measures.
quotes: Central recognized incremental gross profit of $24 million for tariff refunds received, of which $22 million was recognized in its Pet segment and $2 million in its Garden segment.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 8-K earnings release. The release date is not printed in the excerpt, and the item's effective time is November 25, 2026.
material_events.claim: Central published fiscal 2027 guidance of non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better, against fiscal 2026 record non-GAAP EPS of $3.00. It also anticipated a challenging first quarter.
quotes: Central currently expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better.
Delivers record fiscal 2026 GAAP EPS of $3.03 and record non-GAAP EPS of $3.00

risks.basis: Stated in the earnings release. Reading the guide as lower than fiscal 2026 is inferred from comparing the printed figures.
risks.claim: Fourth-quarter organic sales fell 6% (Pet organic down 5%), and fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS is guided at $2.65 or better against $3.00 in fiscal 2026. Management also expects a challenging first quarter.
quotes: Expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better
It also anticipates a challenging first quarter, with opportunities for improvement as the year progresses.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release. Integration risk is inferred from the stated closing conditions and risk-factor list.
risks.claim: The pending TRIXIE deal (up to €400 million) and the just-closed Burpee deal carry closing, integration and purchase-accounting risk. Purchase accounting is expected to leave a minimal contribution to EPS in fiscal 2027.
quotes: The consummation of the Company’s acquisition of TRIXIE is subject to regulatory approval and other customary closing conditions.
Purchase accounting is expected to have a meaningful impact on both acquisitions in fiscal 2027, resulting in a minimal contribution to EPS.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors and business section. The link to the fourth-quarter distribution losses is inferred.

risks.basis: Stated in the release and the 10-K risk factors.

In fiscal 2025, approximately 64% of our Garden segment’s net sales and 57% of our total net sales occurred during our second and third fiscal quarters.

risks.basis: Stated in the release and 10-Q. Impairment risk is inferred.

quotes: Other expense was $7 million compared with $0.5 million, driven primarily by Central's share of initial losses from the pet distribution partnership.

risks.basis: Stated in the release. Whether the 10-K was filed afterwards is not in the evidence.

quotes: Central has not filed its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 26, 2026.
